_reports_accessibility_description: The accessibility report summarizes recurring issues on your pages and helps you prioritize fixes.
_health_legal_accessibility: The current accessibility report for your website is available. Action is required.
_accessibility_subscription: As a site administrator/owner you receive accessibility reports for your website. You can adjust this notification under Settings > Users or unsubscribe here:
_accessibility_subscription_changed: You will no longer receive accessibility reports at the email %email%.
_accessibility_no_results_yet: No test results available yet. Please try again later.
_accessibility_summary: The displayed values represent the average number per subpage. Your report includes %pages% subpages and was last updated %last%.
_accessibility_alt_missing: Images require an alt attribute for description, or must be declared as decorative.
_accessibility_alt_non_descriptive: The alt attribute contains too few words and is not sufficiently descriptive.
_accessibility_link_no_label: A link without visible text requires an `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, or a labeled element.
_accessibility_interactive_no_keyboard_s: An interactive element (`onclick`, `onmousedown`) cannot be operated via keyboard as there is no `tabindex` or `onkeydown`.
_accessibility_interactive_no_role: An interactive element (`onclick`, `onmousedown`) has no `role="button"` or other semantic role.
_accessibility_video_missing_captions: This video has no captions (`<track kind='captions'>`) and is therefore not accessible to hearing-impaired users.
_accessibility_input_hidden_with_label: The control element is described but is invisible.
_accessibility_hidden_focusable: The element is in the DOM but not visible and still focusable.
_accessibility_text_too_small: The text is smaller than 16px and may be difficult to read.
_accessibility_text_too_long: The text is very long and may affect readability.
_accessibility_text_low_contrast: The contrast between text and background is too low.
_accessibility_form_aria_label_only: The input field is only labeled with ARIA attributes. A visible text label is missing.
_accessibility_form_placeholder_only: The input field contains only a placeholder but no visible label.
_accessibility_form_missing_label: The input field has no visible or programmatic label.
_accessibility_headline_missing_h1: There is no main heading (h1) on the page.
_accessibility_headline_multiple_h1: There are multiple h1 headings on the page.
_accessibility_headline_hierarchy: The order of headings violates the logical hierarchy.
_accessibility_headline_too_short: The heading is too short and may not be informative.
_accessibility_aria_invalid_labelledby: The `aria-labelledby` attribute refers to a non-existent element.
_accessibility_aria_invalid_describedby: The `aria-describedby` attribute refers to a non-existent element.
_accessibility_aria_invalid_controls: The `aria-controls` attribute refers to a non-existent element.
_accessibility_aria_role_redundant: The element has a redundant ARIA role.
_accessibility_aria_role_forbidden: The element has a forbidden ARIA role.
_accessibility_aria_missing_main: A <main> element for the main content is missing.
_accessibility_aria_missing_nav: A <nav> element for navigation is missing.
_accessibility_aria_missing_footer: A <footer> element for the end of the page is missing.
_accessibility_aria_multiple_main: Multiple <main> elements found. Only one is allowed.
_accessibility_aria_multiple_header: Multiple <header> elements found. There should only be one global <header>.
_accessibility_aria_multiple_footer: Multiple <footer> elements found. There should only be one global <footer>.
_accessibility_region_no_label: This <section> or <aside> element has neither a heading nor an ARIA label and cannot be uniquely identified by screen readers.
_accessibility_focus_no_outline: The element has no visible focus style.
_accessibility_focus_no_outline_label: A label for an element, as well as the element itself, have no visible focus style.
_accessibility_focus_no_outline_label_he: No visible label focus style present
_accessibility_focus_not_focusable: The visible interactive element cannot receive focus.
_accessibility_focus_target_too_small: This interactive element is smaller than 16×16 pixels or has a total area of less than 576 pixels. This may make it difficult for users with motor limitations to reach. Increase the click area to improve usability.
_accessibility_focus_target_overlapped: The interactive element is covered by another element and is not clickable.
_accessibility_navigatability_skip_none: No skip link was found to comfortably skip navigation.
_accessibility_navigatability_skip_inval: The skip link is not correctly placed before the navigation and main content.
_accessibility_prefers_reduced_motion_mi: A `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback rule is missing for motion or animation effects.
_accessibility_prefers_reduced_motion_to: Animations or transitions last longer than 150ms, although a fallback for `prefers-reduced-motion` is present.
_accessibility_statistics_empty: The daily development will appear here as soon as new audits are available.
